images.caption: Figure 2:AskChem replaces papers with provenance-carrying claims as the retrieval unit, then exposes complementary structure over the shared claim store: a stabilized faceted taxonomy for search and browse, an evidence graph for cross-paper relations, and an exploratory living taxonomy organized by principles.

Figure 3:Corpus-scale coverage and automatic quality checks for the deployed index. These statistics characterize provenance and extraction depth; they do not replace expert judgments of claim semantics or taxonomy placement.

Figure 4:The same “CO2reduction” claims across 10 views: reaction, substance, application, technique, mechanism, data, claim type, and time panels expose faceted structure; author view has a coauthor relationship graph that exposes collaborations; network view displays the evidence graph.

Figure 5:The principle-centered living taxonomy answers what governs a contribution. Unlike the stabilized faceted taxonomy used for search, it organizes indexed papers under principles, theories, models, and mechanisms.
